high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the official Twitter account of "Terminator 2 Movie" (@Terminator2Mov). The tweet is celebrating the 33rd anniversary of the movie "Terminator 2." The text reads: "I'll never say 'hasta la vista' to you, T-800. Happy 33-year anniversary, TERMINATOR 2!" The tweet includes an image of Arnold Schwarzenegger as the T-800 Terminator character from the movie. He is wearing a black leather jacket and sunglasses, sitting on a motorcycle.
